description: This file contains the implementation of the InstanceProfileProvider class, which provides credentials from the EC2 metadata service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles fetching, retrying, token management, and endpoint resolution for EC2 instance profile credentials.

classes.name: Awsedentials"InstanceProfileProvider"
classes.description: Credential provider class that retrieves credentials from the EC2 instance metadata service, supporting token handling, retries, endpoint resolution, and configuration options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with configuration options such as timeout, profile, retries, endpoint, and others.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads instance profile credentials asynchronously, managing token retrieval, profile fetching, and credential decoding.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request to the metadata service endpoint with specified method and headers, and returns a promise with the response body as a string.

methods.name: handleRetryableException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during requests, determining whether to retry or throw an error based on retry options.

methods.name: getExceptionStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from an exception, if available.

methods.name: createErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs a detailed error message for credential retrieval failures.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Decodes the JSON response from the metadata service and validates the success code.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToIMDSv1
methods.description: Determines whether fallback to IMDSv1 is allowed based on configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the full metadata endpoint URL, including latest path, based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: getDefaultEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the default IPv4 or IPv6 endpoint URL based on the endpoint mode.

methods.name: resolveEndpointMode
methods.description: Resolves whether the endpoint mode is IPv4 or IPv6 based on configuration.

methods.name: isValidEndpoint
methods.description: Validates whether a given URI is a proper URL and if non-HTTPS URIs are loopback addresses or default endpoints.
